text:
Seedance 2.5 Video Prompt:

Global lock: Vertical 9:16, one single continuous locked-off shot, 18 seconds. Semi-realistic CG game-cosplay render with fine 3D detail and soft cinematic skin shading — not live-action footage, not flat anime. Character: one young woman cosplaying a game heroine, platinum-white wavy shoulder-length hair with straight bangs, grey-green eyes, fine silver chain bracelets on both wrists, small drop earrings, NO headdress. Costume: an ivory satin modified qipao mini dress — black piping, a frog-button mandarin collar, muted grey ink-floral print, short puff sleeves with ruffled cuffs, open side-waist panels joined by black ring-laced cords, a high side slit finished with a bow and a ruffled flounce; the satin sheen is the costume's signature. Setting: a dark interior, one tall black screen painted with gold-brown floral motifs filling the background behind her, warm wall-lamp glows at both edges, a hint of dark carved furniture at frame right. Framing: she fills about 87 percent of the frame height, head about 13 percent below the top edge, the frame cutting at mid-thigh, face about 12 percent of frame height. Spatial logic: she dances in place before the screen; nothing and nobody else moves. Lighting: warm key from front-left, gentle rim on the white hair, background sinking into black-brown shadow, the ivory satin glowing against the dark. Audio: a mid-tempo pop track at 105.5 BPM, no dialogue, no lyrics work from her — her lips only breathe with the poses. Emotion arc: aloof profile poise — a sly upward glance and smile — open bright gestures — one long statuesque overhead stretch — a soft look back over the shoulder to close.

[00:00-00:02] Three-quarter left profile: head tilted slightly back, lips parted, one hand resting on her thigh, the other on her hip, a slow settle-in sway.
[00:02-00:03] She rotates to face the camera, weight shifting foot to foot, right arm sweeping across and back.
[00:03-00:04] Right index finger points up with a smile; then her chin dips and her eyes lift to the lens from under the brow line — a sly, teasing upward gaze.
[00:04-00:05] Both palms push toward the camera in alternation, palms open, fingers relaxed.
[00:05-00:07] Hands cross low at the waist and settle; her right hand rises behind her head into a pose, body swaying gently, gaze drifting sideways.
[00:07-00:09] The hand-behind-head pose holds through a soft sway; then both hands come to her chest, palms opening outward.
[00:09-00:11] Palms-out gestures at chest height, small pushes and waves on the beat, expression bright and open.
[00:11-00:12] Quick light hand flourishes beside her face and chest, one pointing accent on the beat.
[00:12-00:13] Both hands drop and reset — a one-beat breath.
[00:13-00:15] BOTH ARMS RISE fully overhead and her hands clasp together at the top; the clasp holds for over two seconds while her elongated torso sways gently, lips slightly parted, gaze straight into the lens.
[00:15-00:17] Arms descend to head height; she half-turns, one hand returning behind her head, the other to her hip.
[00:17-00:18] Three-quarter turn, palm turned up in a small beckoning gesture, looking back at the camera as the motion settles to the end.

Negative constraints: no camera movement, no zoom, no cut, no second person, no headdress appearing, no costume change, no piping or floral print morphing, no extra fingers, no warped hands during the palm pushes, no text, no watermark, no logo.
This is a reverse-engineered prompt; the generated result cannot fully match the original video and needs further optimization.
